title: Rubric criterion Pass with acknowledged failures: no-test-regression
description: The no-test-regression criterion was passed with acknowledged_failures: 'anthropic_tests.rs was modified to add 4 new test cases as required by Step 2 of the specification; all pre-existing tests pass without change to their logic.' The criterion's pass condition states 'no test file edited', creating unavoidable tension when a spec explicitly requires adding test coverage.
proposed_resolution: Re-run with the criterion evaluated strictly. A failure is a Fail regardless of whether it is attributed to prior work or the current change. If the failure is genuinely pre-existing, fix it in a separate targeted run first. Alternatively, clarify the no-test-regression criterion to distinguish additive test changes (allowed) from regressive test changes (forbidden).
resolution_summary: Superseded by c9f4e3a2 (consolidated): no-test-regression rubric safe-harbour clause covers spec-required and count-assertion changes.
